description: Synthetic landmark masters for the recorded style-atlas body (style-atlas.json), until analytics-engine serves them (gm-analytics-engine-k1ky). Invented ids and titles, generated with seed 4804: 2 to 10 masters per style, 25 for the six styles with the tightest cells, ranked by release count, and one master that is a landmark of two styles. The mock app merges them into the style-atlas body.
